audio.text: Didn't the library extend its hours for finals week?

options: Only on weekdays, as far as I know.
Yes, I finished my final essay already.
I'm extending my trip until Sunday instead.
The library is right next to the gym.

why.en: A qualified answer (only on weekdays). B says "yes" about something else; C reuses "extend" with another meaning; D answers "where".
why.tr: Kısıtlı bir yanıt (yalnızca hafta içi). B başka bir şey için "evet" diyor; C "extend" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor; D "nerede" sorusuna cevap veriyor.
why.es: Una respuesta con matiz (solo entre semana). B dice "sí" a otra cosa; C reutiliza "extend" con otro significado; D responde a "where".
